name: Minimax
description: 提前推演双方几步，选择对自己更有利、让对手更难应对的落点。

name: Padded-CNN + PUCT
description: 把棋盘当作图像识别局部布局，再通过搜索挑选落点。

name: Grid-GNN + PUCT
description: 根据三角网格中相邻节点的关系判断局面，再通过搜索挑选落点。

name: Topology-GNN + PUCT
description: 同时考虑网格邻接与双方实际连线，再通过搜索挑选落点。

name: DQN
description: 从对局经验中学习每个动作的长期收益，优先选择估计收益较高的落点。

name: PPO
description: 通过逐步、受控地调整落子策略，从对局经验中学习如何行动。

name: SAC
description: 在追求收益的同时保留探索，学习兼顾不同落子可能性的策略。

name: GAIL
description: 通过区分示例落子与自己的选择，学习模仿贪心策略的下法。

name: GAN
description: 让生成器与判别器相互训练，学习产生接近贪心策略示例的落子。

name: Minimax
description: Looks several moves ahead for both players and chooses a move that improves its position while limiting your replies.

name: Padded-CNN + PUCT
description: Reads local board patterns as an image, then uses search to choose a move.

name: Grid-GNN + PUCT
description: Reads relationships between neighboring points on the triangular grid, then uses search to choose a move.

name: Topology-GNN + PUCT
description: Reads both grid neighbors and each player's actual connections, then uses search to choose a move.

name: DQN
description: Learns the long-term value of each action and favors moves with a higher estimated return.

name: PPO
description: Learns a move policy through gradual, controlled updates from game experience.

name: SAC
description: Balances expected return with exploration while learning its move policy.

name: GAIL
description: Learns to imitate a greedy strategy by distinguishing example moves from its own choices.

name: GAN
description: Uses a generator and discriminator to learn moves that resemble a greedy strategy's examples.
